title: Could AI chip boom make ASML Europe's first trillion-dollar firm?
title_zh: AI芯片热潮能让ASML成为欧洲第一家万亿美元公司吗？
summary: The global artificial intelligence boom has propelled ASML to the top of Europe's stock market, as soaring demand for AI computer chips flows to the Dutch company that dominates the market for the equipment needed to ‌make them.
summary_zh: 全球人工智能热潮将 ASML 推上了欧洲股市的榜首，因为对 AI 计算机芯片的需求不断飙升，这家荷兰公司在制造这些芯片所需的设备市场上占据主导地位。

title: Analysis-Could AI chip boom make ASML Europe's first trillion-dollar firm?

title: Bezos Backs AI Startup to Discover New Materials for Chipmaking
title_zh: 贝佐斯支持人工智能初创公司发现芯片制造新材料
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Producing the world’s most in-demand semiconductors requires enormous amounts of energy and access to rare minerals. CuspAI, a two-year-old British startup, has raised nearly half a billion dollars on its bet that artificial intelligence can improve that process.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——生产世界上需求量最大的半导体需要大量的能源和稀有矿物。 CuspAI 是一家成立两年的英国初创公司，它已筹集了近 5 亿美元资金，押注人工智能可以改善这一过程。
